criteria.closureCriterion: Record a committed, source-reviewed inventory of production modules/functions, entrypoints, Cargo features and platform variants. Classify tests, generated files, application code and explicitly untranslated dependency internals separately. Retain baseline paths/revision; do not reuse an old function denominator.

Assign every production inventory entry to one or more numbered rows and a real implementation/adoption path; list each unresolved construct, binding and feature gap. Draft an inventory reconciliation mechanism so unassigned/new entries cannot silently disappear.

Finish layout-aware imports, package/build/publish entrypoints, CLI/tool paths and documentation for all three physical source trees; eliminate active assumptions that application source is root `src`.
Declare authored versus generated ownership for all three trees and meta/source assets, generation destinations and overwrite protections; draft stale/missing/wrong-root cases.

Draft copied-repository layout/adoption instructions and independent relocation/package/import cases that exercise actual `js/src`, `ts/src`, `rust/src` and translator paths without depending on the original checkout.

Register every application syntax/operation family from L01/L02 in extensible rule tables, using exactly language then repository sequences; each missing registration is assigned, never silently carried.

Implement shared language substitutions for inventoried expressions, declarations, control flow and type/ownership/effect constraints, with inverse/refusal source cases; repository spelling cannot grant semantic authority.

Implement repository bindings, facade adoption, imports, hygiene, formatting and output conventions for those families, separate from language semantics; include shadowing/ambiguity/conflicting-name cases.

Drive applicable forward/reverse registrations, target declarations and bulk caller proposals from shared operation descriptions or source-derived templates; preserve independent oracle expectations and original APIs.

Draft complete rule-composition/discovery orchestration and dependency/conflict handling, including nested original-span edits, idempotence, complete inverses and bounded refusal; one rule must not erase another's needed source evidence.
Carry original Rust source through lossless CST serialization/reparse on every forward lane, retaining tokens/trivia/delimiters/spans and malformed-input refusal.
Carry original JS and TS source through the same lossless boundary on every reverse lane, including written type syntax, comments, templates and complete module source.
Define/extend checked semantic meta schemas, serializers/reparsers, independent checkers and both interpreters for every new operation; distinguish transported source from semantic authority.

Retain genuine private parser/source/type/caller receipts through emission and closing checks; draft stale/forged/mutated/caught-failure cases, with no authority from public flags, names or hashes and no new persistent verdict caches.
Draft exact source-inverse and complete canonical reproduction paths for all lanes and composed histories, including mixed Rust/JS/TS source equations and source/export dependency pins.
Complete inventoried scalar/text/formatting/JSON/codec operations with matching native/JS implementations, strict TS declarations, errors, numeric/Unicode semantics and actual caller mappings.

Complete inventoried collection/iterator operations: construction, mutation, lookup/order, nested aggregates, callbacks/captures and borrowed results. Finish genuine native join-kernel routing, preserving ownership and resource behavior.

Complete inventoried Option/Result/early-return/Try/error-conversion operations and callback/local/branch/loop composition, retaining evaluation order, move/loan lifetimes and explicit error variants.

Complete inventoried shared-state/async/network/HTTP/stream contracts with matching cancellation, ordering, backpressure, termination and error semantics; framework internals may remain behind qualified facades.

Complete inventoried filesystem/process/environment/time/platform operations with matching resource lifecycle and failure contracts; list native implementation boundaries and application domains explicitly.
Resolve original modules/imports/reexports/aliases/visibility and qualified function/type references across the inventoried source set; preserve ambiguity and shadowing refusals.
Resolve actual attributes/cfg/features/platform selections and macro/derive/include producers used by that set, retaining original generated-source provenance rather than guessed expansions.
Resolve actual type/trait/impl/method/generic/default-context ownership needed by callers; qualified facade bindings must be joined to their actual implementation and dependency configuration.
Close cross-module helper/caller/result/field/constructor relationships, including nonasync and async effects, argument-duration borrows, reference lifetimes and whole-body ownership checks.
Draft complete-scope unresolved-binding diagnostics and source/adoption refusal cases; every unresolved producer/owner maps back to L02 instead of blanket namespace admission.
Lower all inventoried expressions, statements, branches/loops/matches, returns and helper calls through checked meta to executable JS and strict TS; preserve effects and refusal domains.
Lower inventoried records/enums/constructors/fields/generics/traits and aggregate/reference ownership through matching target abstractions, including mutation and drop/resource obligations.
Lower inventoried async/state/network/streaming application callers through O04/O05 contracts with complete control flow, cancellation and error paths.

Draft complete project-driver/dependency/import/runtime packaging for canonical and neutral/Unix/Windows outputs, owned definitions and all production entrypoints; do not manually patch generated outputs.
Provide actual whole-function/module production source cases for all inventoried families plus a future census mechanism distinguishing executable, partial, refused and carried bodies with reasons.
Define the editable JS/TS application subset from L01, including JS type witnesses and written TS types; retain dynamic/coercion/unknown-source refusals and useful diagnostics.
Map all corresponding scalar/core/collection/error/aggregate operations through checked meta and ownership replay into Rust and strict TS, across every active reverse lane.
Map corresponding async/state/network/resource operations and whole production callers back to Rust, with complete dependency/type/import emission and native contracts.
Implement both paired-target edit directions, canonical Rust reproduction and JS↔TS projection consistency; distinguish canonical source changes from exact restoration of untouched source/trivia.
Draft independent whole-module reverse cases for all inventoried families, including unsupported JS/TS, ownership conflicts, tampered witnesses and roundtrip error/effect preservation.
Complete actual Rust-edited and JS/TS-edited synchronization entrypoints through CST/meta and both rule sequences; retain authored-source overwrite protections.
Complete exact baseline/direction/conflict handling for independent, identical and concurrent differing changes, including paired JS/TS conflicts, renames/deletions and dependency edits.
Complete source-reader/closing/failure protocols and bounded atomic installation/rollback/recovery; stale/restored/caught-failure inputs must invalidate private facts and preserve primary errors.

Draft deterministic fresh output orchestration for source banks, canonical/platform/owned/reverse assets, runtime/type mirrors, meta and export profiles; no manual expected-hash replacement or stale generated acceptance.
Draft end-to-end copied-project edit/sync/second-edit/conflict/recovery cases in both directions and no-op/idempotence checks, without relying on original checkout caches.
Map every inventoried CLI/configuration/account/authentication/credential/provider/model-selection operation to matching target behavior and independent production contract cases.
Map every inventoried endpoint/routing/proxy/header/protocol/error/stream feature to matching target behavior, including cancellation, termination, ordering and platform variants.
Map every inventoried storage/network-token operation, policy/authorization/quota/usage/subscription/lifecycle/state behavior to matching target implementations and failure cases.
Map every inventoried client/session/login/process/tunnel/deploy/service/logging/telemetry capability to matching target behavior, explicit external boundaries and platform cases.

Reconcile the complete feature/route/entrypoint manifest against L01/L02 and all historical parity gaps; every application gap needs implementation/case source, with no unsupported feature counted as parity.

Draft independently expected semantic vectors for every inventoried operation and complete production caller family, shared across JS/TS and native oracle source without generating expectations from implementation tables.
Draft boundary/error/refusal vectors for Unicode, numeric limits, malformed input, source identities, stale/forged receipts, coercion, resource caps and unsupported domains.
Draft ownership/evaluation-order/lifetime/mutation/branch/loop/callback/alias cases, including later-argument move/restore and nested borrowed results in real callers.
Draft async/cancellation/stream/order/state/platform and resource-cleanup cases, including independent real route/CLI/storage contracts and controlled external-service fixtures.
Draft complete Node/Bun/strict lockfile TypeScript and CI-only Rust harness coverage mapping, whole-file scheduling, original deadlines/raw evidence and explicit skipped-work accounting.
Draft shared-source-history/fixture/native-parser/derive/binding repairs for recorded failure classes and independent regressions; preserve full originals and provenance.
Draft invocation-local allocation/CPU/lifecycle improvements for recorded metadata/retained-storage/source-check bottlenecks; preserve guards and avoid persistent source/owner/verdict caches.
Draft complete actual native join-helper→kernel emission routing through genuine private checked body/caller evidence, plus full-capacity independent cases without reducing original bounds/deadlines.
Draft canonical/platform/owned/reverse/export freshness and strict TypeScript repair paths with complete source equations, original producers and all unchanged commands.

Draft a later complete-cycle failure collector/classifier and repair worklist preserving raw failures and SHA/workloads; newly discovered failures reopen affected rows instead of being hidden or assumed repaired.
Account for all eight unchanged JavaScript stage IDs/commands and every original matrix member/profile/engine, preserving fail-fast false, deadlines and raw test evidence.
Require success for all JavaScript stages at the same immutable SHA before any Rust job executes; skipped/cancelled/missing work cannot unlock Rust.
Keep all required Rust CI checks fatal after the JS gate, with native edge/oracle coverage and explicit skipped-work handling; no local Rust invocation or commit-hook Rust tool.
Connect complete forward/reverse/freshness/strict parity/export/receiving and production-case jobs to the original partitions, preserving credentials/platform boundaries and bounded resources.
Draft workflow/source-equation/partition audits and positive/negative gate cases for failed/missing/mismatched-SHA JS stages and fatal Rust outcomes; workflow presence alone is not verification.
Include the full compiler/rule/CST/meta/parser/schema/runtime/type/source-profile dependency closure in a standalone export with explicit source provenance and unchanged size/resource limits.
Carry upstream reference/pin/license/notice obligations for copied approaches and dependencies; document local changes and distinguish reused source from reimplementation.

Draft independent receiving-repository cases that import the full compiler, translate real source in both directions, synchronize edits, and retain semantic/source/failure checks without original checkout access.
Draft reusable installation/layout/core-binding/extension/adoption instructions and automation; make repository-specific rules replaceable without weakening reusable language rules.

Draft receiving closure/freshness/platform/resource diagnostics and limitations, plus contribution guidance covering layered rules, independent cases, JS-first gating and no unsupported full-sync claim.

Preserve source-only drafting/no experiments/no CI-feedback inspection policy until complete bulk draft, continued prohibition of local tests/compilation until authorized, and no local Rust tools in any phase.
Record single coordinator/publisher, no restarted workers, hook disabling for conflicting Rust tools, standing push authorization and coherent checkpoint cadence without weakening JS-first CI.
Document bounded disk/memory/time/evidence handling, one heavy workload, no unnecessary dependency trees/clones, precise Router-owned cleanup and preservation of others' active work.
Complete checkpoint/handoff/PR templates recording exact source SHA, open IDs, unrun/failed/passed scope, reproduction paths, cleanup and explicit paused/resume status.

Define truthful final delivery: all 70 source receipts before draft-complete claim; independently completed coverage/parity/freshness/receiving/performance and same-SHA JS→Rust CI evidence before verified completion or release claims.

scope: Original70 technical/local-policy acceptance bundles; separate original-issue obligations are mapped in the report.
